name: tag-group
purpose: Interactive tags such as applied filters, recipients, or labels on a record: removable, selectable (single or multiple), or both. A grid with one row per tag: one tag in the tab sequence, arrow keys between tags, Space selects, Delete or Backspace removes.
whenToUse: Applied filters the user can remove one by one.
A short set of labels the user selects to filter or categorize.
Recipients or assignees shown as removable chips.
whenNotToUse: Static status or category labels: use Badge.
Choosing values in a form field: use Multi Select (its chips are part of the field).
responsive: Tags wrap onto several lines; long labels are truncated with an ellipsis.
rtl: Arrow keys follow the reading direction; the remove button sits at the inline end.
theme: Component tokens tag-group-bg, tag-group-border-color, tag-group-radius (contrast gate pairs); selected tags use color-selected, color-selected-text, and color-selected-indicator. Forced colors draw selected tags in Highlight.
security: Labels are rendered with textContent; never parsed as HTML.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. Removal changes only the displayed tags; the application updates its own data from aui-remove.

performance.testedScale: Up to 1,000 tags accepted; intended for tens.

limitations: Removing the last tag leaves focus on the page body; move focus to a sensible control in an aui-remove handler.
Every change re-creates the tag elements (focus is restored to the same tag).
antiPatterns: Using a tag group for static labels (use Badge).
Removing tags without a way to add them back.
